name: Electronics
calibration: Starting weights from the ShelfScout V2 specification. They are an uncalibrated hypothesis, not validated ratings, and must be calibrated with expert review and user research.

gates.why: A product can't be recommended outright without a safety assessment.

safety_requirements.name: FCC equipment authorization (radio and digital devices)
CE marking under the Radio Equipment Directive (radio devices)
UKCA or CE marking (radio and electrical equipment)
BIS registration under the Compulsory Registration Scheme (listed electronics)
UN 38.3 transport testing for lithium batteries

requirements_reviewed: 2026-11 from general regulatory knowledge; confirm current rules for the product and country
